analysis_rules.availability: report available fact slots and rows with an available category
analysis_rules.classification: parse each row's actual facts and query; q1 need not have both confounds
decision_order: slot majority and either q0 attribute majority => JOINT_POSITION_ATTRIBUTE
analysis_rules.empty_denominator: rate and flag unavailable (null); never majority evidence
analysis_rules.logit_difference: float64 full-vocabulary absolute-difference summaries; no candidate filtering
analysis_rules.paired_contrast: float64: (z_left[a]-z_left[b])-(z_right[a]-z_right[b]); a=left target, b=right target; report positive/zero/negative
analysis_rules.pairs: questions 0/1 and 2/3; location swaps 0/2 and 1/3, within each canonical group
analysis_rules.scope: descriptive construction-only localization; no causal or capacity verdict
analysis_rules.target_margin: own-target logit minus maximum over all 4095 other vocabulary IDs
